mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, as low interest rates reduce the discount rate for equity cash flows and encourage risk-taking in financial markets.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5% (p-value > 0.05 in t-test vs. baseline).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in CPIAUCSL above 0.5% signals rising inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, which reduces equity valuations and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when CPIAUCSL monthly increase > 0.5% (p-value > 0.05 in t-test vs. baseline).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) and decline in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals a deteriorating labor market, which reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises > 0.2pp and PAYEMS falls > 10k in the last month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE rises > 0.2pp and PAYEMS falls > 10k (p-value > 0.05 in t-test vs. baseline).

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (defined by FEDFUNDS rising for 3 consecutive months), a rise in the federal funds rate leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days as investors anticipate reduced liquidity and higher borrowing costs.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS has risen for 3 consecutive months (p-value > 0.05 in t-test vs. baseline).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1600 thousand units signals a weakening real estate market, reducing consumer confidence and corporate investment, which produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when HOUST < 1600 (p-value > 0.05 in t-test vs. baseline).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above 0.3% signals robust economic activity, which supports corporate earnings and produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO monthly increase > 0.3% (p-value > 0.05 in t-test vs. baseline).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and residential fixed investment (RSAFS) signals a housing market contraction, reducing consumer wealth and business investment, which produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST falls > 5% and RSAFS falls > 2% in the last month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when HOUST falls > 5% and RSAFS falls > 2% (p-value > 0.05 in t-test vs. baseline).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in quarterly GDP (GDPC1) growth below 0.5% signals an economic slowdown, reducing corporate earnings expectations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when GDPC1 quarterly growth < 0.5% (p-value > 0.05 in t-test vs. baseline).
